parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources. Array length: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- instance: ECS instance.
- disk: cloud disk.
- snapshot: snapshot.
- image: image.
- securitygroup: security group.
- volume: storage volume.
- eni: Elastic Network Interface (ENI).
- ddh: dedicated host.
- ddhcluster: dedicated host cluster.
- keypair: SSH key pair.
- launchtemplate: launch template.
- reservedinstance: reserved instance.
- snapshotpolicy: automatic snapshot policy.
- elasticityassurance: elasticity assurance.
- capacityreservation: capacity reservation.
- command: Cloud Assistant command.
- invocation: Cloud Assistant command execution or file sending result.
- activation: Cloud Assistant managed instance activation code.
- managedinstance: Cloud Assistant managed instance.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. Array length: 1 to 20. If the array contains multiple tag objects, the tag key `Key` must be unique.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The tag value cannot be null but can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
